title: #960 adjudicated: dynamic wiring reaches the declared member
body: Source verdict from CLUSTERWORMS.py: _resolve_worm_dynamic looks up the registry class and calls _execute_worm_class, which instantiates the declared class and invokes its primary parameterless method (standard-method priority order with full public-method scan fallback). get_summary is a registry metadata method, not the dispatch target. Dispatch reaches the member.

title: #978 open: no fail-closed guard mirror in DirectMemory
body: direct_memory.py carries only timestamp fail-closed, SELECT read-only, and atexit guards; the production-site fail-closed guard from the task is absent. The 56-of-57 closure belongs to the owning lane.

title: #972/#1024 with owning lanes, not verifiable from here
body: #972 needs Kilo's 13-commit range plus ADOPT wire flag-gating evidence from its lane; #1024 (3-changeset commit of the 70-file backlog) sits behind the Kilo CLI crash noted in #1006. Neither is checkable from history alone.
